knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: Operations involving tensor views and non-contiguous memory layouts may expose backend assumptions about storage organization.

risk_dimensions.shape: Output view shapes and slicing operations may affect execution behavior.
risk_dimensions.dtype: Floating point operations may activate specialized backend paths.
risk_dimensions.memory: Non-contiguous layouts and tensor views should be explored.
risk_dimensions.device: Different devices may contain independent backend implementations.
risk_dimensions.execution_state: Operations using output tensors may introduce additional states.

failure_mechanism.description: Backend implementations may incorrectly handle writes into non-contiguous tensor views.

input_exploration: Explore contiguous and non-contiguous memory layouts.
constraint_awareness: Consider storage layout instead of only tensor values.
oracle_strategy: Compare results against contiguous reference execution.

important_considerations: Tensor view operations may expose hidden storage assumptions.
llm_reasoning_guidance.generation_strategy: Generate diverse tensor view configurations instead of reproducing one device-specific bug.
